title: Fishing Game
description: Cast your line and catch as many fish as you can.
about:
Fishing Game is a browser game where you press and release at the right moments to control the fishing indicator and catch fish.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Press and release at the right moments to control the fishing indicator and catch fish.
tips: Use mouse / touch / keyboard to hold and release the indicator.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Fishing Game?
faq.answer: Press and release at the right moments to control the fishing indicator and catch fish.

faq.question: Can I play Fishing Game in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
